page.overview:
Who is Anger?

Anger was one of five female Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt on the Wellspring of Life. Anger expressed the emotion anger during his mystical exploration of The Force.

Like her four other forms, whom she referred to as cousins, Anger was Force-sensitive and possessed the ability to shape-shift. She had yellow eyes and gray skin, both of which were manifestations, and was 1.85 meters (6 feet, 1 inch) tall.

The Force Priestess was first introduced in "Destiny", the twelfth episode of the sixth season of the animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars. Like the other four Force Priestesses, Anger's voice was provided by American actress Jaime King.
